answer: Each account must paint one pigment mural on a registered terrace at the vertex of the harbour wall. The painter mixes the pigment, paints the mural, and signs the mural record with the terrace mark. Two verifiers check the record and the mural against the mural register within a week, and a record tied to a second account voids both claims. The mural and pigment cost 4,000,000 rupiah, so 1,000 fake identities would spend 4,000,000,000 rupiah.
